items.stem: Which EF Core method marks related data to be loaded together with the primary entity in a single query?

options.rationale: Correct: Include (with ThenInclude for nesting) performs eager loading of related data.
AsNoTracking disables change tracking; it does not load related data.
SaveChanges persists tracked changes; it is not a loading method.
FromSqlRaw runs raw SQL; it does not by itself eager-load navigations.

items.explanation: Correct: Include (with ThenInclude for nesting) performs eager loading of related data.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about EF Core change tracking are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Entities returned from a tracking query are monitored for changes until the DbContext is disposed
options.rationale: Correct: tracked entities drive updates and remain tracked until the context is disposed or cleared.

options.text: AsNoTracking queries skip snapshot tracking and are suited to read-only results
options.rationale: Correct: no-tracking queries are faster for read-only data because no snapshot is taken.

options.text: SaveChanges tracks entities even after the DbContext is disposed
options.rationale: A disposed context no longer tracks anything.

options.text: Change tracking requires calling DetectChanges manually before every query
options.rationale: EF Core detects changes automatically at SaveChanges; manual DetectChanges is rarely needed.

items.explanation: Correct: tracked entities drive updates and remain tracked until the context is disposed or cleared.

items.stem: What is the correct way to evolve the database schema in an EF Core project?

options.text: Create a migration from the updated model and apply it
options.rationale: Correct: migrations capture model changes as versioned, repeatable schema updates.

options.text: Manually alter the database and ignore the model
options.rationale: Hand edits drift from the model and break future migrations.

options.text: Delete and recreate the production database on each deploy
options.rationale: That destroys data and is not a migration strategy.

options.text: Edit the migration history table directly
options.rationale: Editing the history table by hand corrupts migration state.

items.explanation: Correct: migrations capture model changes as versioned, repeatable schema updates.
